Govinda visits Lalbaugcha Raja with co-star amid wife's allegations

Actor Govinda visited the Lalbaugcha Raja Ganpati pandal in Mumbai with his 'Roopa' co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar. This visit occurred hours after his wife, Sunita Ahuja, visited the same location alone. The visits come amid allegations of cheating made by Sunita Ahuja.
